title: yeasty velvety irish comte pudding
description: a rich and creamy pudding featuring comte cheese, perfect for a midnight craving
instructions: grease six 1/2-cup ramekins with the additional 2 tablespoons of butter.
in a medium saucepan, warm the milk over low heat until it starts to simmer.
in a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and yeast.
add the warm milk to the dry ingredients and whisk until a smooth batter forms.
add the comte cheese, eggs, vanilla extract, and kosher salt to the batter, and whisk until well combined.
divide the batter evenly among the prepared ramekins and smooth the tops.
place the ramekins on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 18-20 minutes, or until the puddings are puffed and golden brown.
remove the puddings from the oven and let them cool in the ramekins for 5 minutes.
run a knife around the edges of each pudding to loosen it, then invert onto plates and serve immediately.
